name: Pezid
beschreibung: Pezid is a family-friendly aparthotel in Serfaus at an altitude of 1,427 metres, in the heart of the Tyrolean Oberland in the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis holiday region. The apartments for two to eight people are furnished with fully equipped kitchens, regional wood and large windows with mountain views. Amenities include a panoramic indoor pool on the fourth floor, a sauna area with Finnish sauna and steam bath, and a fitness area. In winter the ski slope is almost at the door, in summer the hiking trails start right nearby. The Komperdellbahn cable car and the village centre can be reached on foot in just a few minutes. Parking spaces are available directly at the house.
